Reader Test Novel

Prologue

After the rain stopped, every street reflected the pale morning sky. Mira folded the map and stepped onto the train.

Chapter 1: The Station

The station was almost empty. A conductor checked Mira's ticket and pointed toward the final carriage.

Chapter 2 — The Valley

The train entered a narrow valley. Beyond the glass, Mira noticed a small town that did not appear on her map.

Epilogue

Years later, she returned to the same river and understood why the journey had mattered.
